records.title:
DELAY IN PUBLICATION OF AAIB FINAL REPORT ON AI-171 
CRASH
details:
The investigation is under progress. All probable causes and contributing factors leading to 
the accident are being investigated. 
The final investigation report (including all the findings) will be made public and published 
on Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) website after completion of the 
investigation.
